title: Job process could not be started
message: The process of job {job_id} could not be started: {reason}.
fix_text: Try again; if it keeps happening, run the hardware check.

title: Worker didn't register in time
message: The worker of job {job_id} didn't register within {timeout_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: This task didn't start in time.
fix_text: Try again; if it keeps happening, reinstall the environment.

title: Signal not delivered to a job
basic_text: Rastai couldn't pass this request on to the task.
fix_text: Refresh the job list; if the task is still running, try again.

title: Job killed by a signal
basic_text: This task stopped before it finished.

title: Job killed by the kernel's out-of-memory killer
message: Job {job_id} was killed by the kernel's out-of-memory killer.
basic_text: This computer ran out of memory, so the system stopped the task.
fix_text: Close other programs, or use a smaller batch or model.

title: Job killed by the node
message: Job {job_id} was killed by the node: {reason}.
basic_text: This task stopped before it finished.
fix_text: Check the node's log for the reason, then run it again.

title: Worker exited with no final record or diagnostic
message: The worker of job {job_id} exited with code {exit_code} and no final record or diagnostic.
basic_text: This task stopped before it finished. It didn't say why.
fix_text: Check the job's stderr.log, then run it again.

title: Worker couldn't start
message: The worker of job {job_id} couldn't start: {reason}.
fix_text: Reinstall the environment, then try again.

title: Job token rejected
message: The token of job {job_id} was rejected.
basic_text: A task tried to connect with a key Rastai doesn't accept.
fix_text: Run the task again; if it keeps happening, restart the node.

title: Worker protocol version not supported by this node; stopped with a checkpoint
message: The worker of job {job_id} speaks protocol version {version}, which this node doesn't support; it stopped with a checkpoint.
basic_text: This task and Rastai are different versions. The task saved its progress and stopped.
fix_text: Update Rastai, then resume the run.

title: Job ended while no node was watching; no final state
message: Job {job_id} ended while no node was watching, so it has no final state.
basic_text: This task ended while Rastai wasn't running, so its result is unknown.
fix_text: Check its output, or run it again.

title: Job didn't reconnect after a node restart
message: Job {job_id} didn't reconnect after the node restarted.
basic_text: This task didn't come back after Rastai restarted.

title: Job lost with the daemon; resubmitted
message: Job {job_id} was lost with the daemon and resubmitted.
basic_text: This task was interrupted when Rastai stopped, so it started again.

title: Job ran inside the daemon and stopped with it
message: Job {job_id} ran inside the daemon and stopped with it.
basic_text: This task stopped when Rastai stopped.

title: Another worker is already writing this run's event log
message: Another process is writing the event log {path}, so this job stopped before writing to it.
basic_text: This task is already running, so Rastai didn't start a second copy of it.
fix_text: Wait for the running copy to finish, or cancel it, then try again.
